description:
Get the price level of each apartment for a whole month plus that month's booking rules.

Use when the guest has no exact dates yet ("what does a week in July cost?", "when is it cheapest?").
For each apartment it returns the lowest total price of a real reference stay in that month (usually 7
nights, incl. final cleaning and tourist tax) and the arrival days / minimum stay / closures of the month.
Not for exact prices on specific dates — use check_availability for that. Visual version:
render_rates_card with the same arguments.
Behaviour: read-only, live from the booking system (about 1-2 s, cached 5 min). Returns text plus
structuredContent (apartments, periods, weeks, perks, offers).
